selected_evidence.requirement: usb-storage module is prevented from loading now (immediate effect)
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed module unloaded; blacklist/install config written; modprobe attempt fails with 'could not insert usb_storage: Invalid argument' and lsmod confirms it stayed unloaded.

selected_evidence.requirement: usb-storage module is prevented from loading after reboot (persistence)
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-restart baseline captured config presence; post-restart check shows the same config file intact, module absent from lsmod, and a fresh modprobe attempt still fails identically.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 5fb1b173..., issued backgrounded systemctl reboot (ack returned as pid 1352), observed a connection timeout mid-reboot, then reconnected with new boot_id 188bba31... and later boot time, and confirmed post-restart the usb-storage blacklist configuration and its blocking behavior remained fully functional.
